verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms an llms.txt file served at docs.lorikeetcx.ai/llms.txt (HTTP 200). It links to markdown versions of the docs, such as the MCP server page, so an agent can be pointed at agent-readable documentation. missing for 10: evidence of how broadly llms.txt covers the full docs set (only the MCP server entry is visible), first-party documentation describing the agent-oriented docs offering (e.g. an llms-full.txt or guidance for agents).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
